mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate orthostatic hypotension and reduce the efficacy of levodopa; thiazides may also interfere with levodopa's antiparkinsonian effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, and Parkinson's symptom control; consider alternative antihypertensive if orthostatic hypotension or worsening motor symptoms develop.
